precision: Full BF16, adapter merged after exact tensor verification
implementation_differences: No JSON repair, retries, guessed scores or default values; invalid outputs fail calibration

gates.each_task: Admitted result must beat both no-edit and opposite-direction candidates in BOTH languages; any tie/invalid counts as failure.
gates.quality_rule: Admitted quality must strictly beat known damaged render under min(naturalness,artifacts); ties/invalid fail. These are minor defects, not a major-damage detection certification.

scope: Only the already used round7 training160 photo groups. No developer or acceptance photos are loaded. Not an independent test; external model training overlap with GIER is unknown.
limitations: Small AI-labelled calibration, not human endorsement or proof of reward reliability. Official prompt assumes generated images although these are photographs; domain transfer explicitly tested.
quality_calibration: Eight minor-defect comparisons only, not certification for major-damage detection; some PQ images answer different requests, and PQ has no instruction input.
posthoc_policy: Do not modify threshold, cases, prompt or parsing after seeing results. A failure stops use of this configuration as a training reward. Report all errors and ties.
